prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Pick Starter Accessories for Your New Desktop Pet", "Equip your pet with initial gear before signing the official adoption certificate."]
1: ["Master Your Desktop Pet Controls", "Learn how to interact, minimize to system tray, and summon your pet on demand.", "Controls: Right-click pet for menu, double-click to chat, drag to reposition on desktop."]
2: ["Sign In Early to Preserve Desktop Pet Sync", "Signing in now secures your cloud saves so customized pets never get lost."]
3: ["Select Your Desktop Companion Archetype", "Preview live pet behaviors on active windows before choosing."]
4: ["Returning user? Sign in with your original credentials to automatically restore saved desktop pets.", "Avoid using alternative sign in providers if you previously adopted pets under a different account."]
5: ["Initializing Desktop Engine & Overlay", "Checking graphic engine compatibility and system tray overlay permissions.", "Desktop overlay compatibility verified", "Loading desktop mascot assets..."]
6: ["Complete Adoption to Claim Founder's Desktop Badge", "Finalizing your adoption certificate grants your pet an exclusive Founder's Badge visible on your desktop.", "Founder's Desktop Badge Unlocked"]
7: ["Play audio chime when pet spawns"]
8: ["Discover Your Interactive Desktop Companion", "Scroll down to see live companion behaviors and workspace integration."]
9: ["Your Companion is Ready! Access via System Tray", "Your pet is now active on your screen. Right-click its tray icon anytime to pause, hide, or open controls.", "Launch Desktop Companion"]

verdicts.problem: Creates urgency or scarcity by offering an exclusive Founder's Badge as a reward.
